steps.en: Open the reading guide with a concrete evaluation question
steps.zh: 带着具体评价问题打开阅读指南

steps.en: Group methods by update target and expose searchable evidence
steps.zh: 按修改对象分类，并提供可搜索证据

steps.en: Choose a method and open its primary comparison
steps.zh: 选择方法并打开其主要比较

steps.en: Show four separate judgments with supporting passages and coverage
steps.zh: 分开展示四项判定、依据及覆盖范围

steps.en: Check the primary report before using its claim in your protocol
steps.zh: 核对原报告，再将结论用于自己的评价协议

value.en: A source-linked evaluation map, not an unverified self-improvement promise
value.zh: 得到可追溯的评价地图，而非未经验证的自进化承诺
